description: This file defines the GuavaMultiPageResultSet class, which implements the ResultSet interface to handle multi-page Cassandra query results with pagination support, including iteration over rows and fetching additional pages.

classes.name: GuavaMultiPageResultSet
classes.description: Implements a paginated ResultSet for Cassandra queries, supporting iteration over rows and automatic fetching of subsequent pages.

classes.name: RowIterator
classes.description: Inner class extending CountingIterator to iterate over rows across multiple pages, handling pagination logic.

methods.name: GuavaMultiPageResultSet
methods.description: Constructor initializing the paginated result set with the first page of results.

methods.name: getColumnDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the column definitions for the result set.

methods.name: getExecutionInfos
methods.description: Returns the list of execution info objects for each page fetched.

methods.name: isFullyFetched
methods.description: Indicates whether all pages have been fetched.

methods.name: getAvailableWithoutFetching
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining rows available without fetching more pages.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the rows in the result set.

methods.name: wasApplied
methods.description: Indicates whether the last query was successfully applied.
